title: Friday 230901
wodRaw:
3 rounds for time of:    
50 [hip extensions](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-ghd-hip-extension)   
25 [strict pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-strict-pull-up)   
Run 800 meters

Post time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230901).

**Scaling:**  
Newer athletes should consider decreasing the reps of each movement. If you do not yet have strict pull-ups, use a band or modify to a ring row. 

**Intermediate Option:**  
3 rounds for time of:  
**35** hip extensions   
**15** strict pull-ups   
Run 800 meters

**Beginner Option:**  
3 rounds for time of:  
**25** hip extensions   
**15 ring rows**    
Run **400 meters**

title: Monday 230904

title: Friday 230908
wodRaw:
Clean and jerk 1-1-1-1-1 reps 

Then, 

For time:   
10 clean and jerks at 70% of your heaviest single   
10 clean and jerks at 80% of your heaviest single   

Record 1-rep max clean and jerk to the [CrossFit App](https://qrcodes.pro/HLEFX0). Post heavy single and time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230908). 

**Scaling:**   
Newer athletes should use today’s workout as an opportunity to practice the clean and jerk. Watch [The Clean and Jerk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-clean-and-jerk), and focus on developing the skill. For the 20 reps for time, choose weights that are challenging but with which you can maintain proper technique.

title: Monday 230911
wodRaw:
[Hero workout of your choice.](https://www.crossfit.com/heroes/)   
Review the list of heroes and honor one with an all-out effort.

Post choice of workout and results to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230911).
Compare to [220530](https://www.crossfit.com/230529).

**Scaling:**   
Most Hero workouts are meant to be extremely grueling, arduous, and mentally challenging. Many contain a very high volume of reps. As we’re just coming off of the Filthy Fifty, make sure you pick a Hero workout that allows you to keep moving. Hero workouts that emphasize moderate rep ranges and time domains (10-30 reps/movement, approximately 15-20-minute range) are good choices as well.

title: Tuesday 230912

[Overhead squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat) 5-5-5 reps  
[Front squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-front-squat) 3-3-3 reps  
[Back squat](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-back-squat) 1-1-1 reps

Post loads to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230912).

Experienced athletes can perform this heavy day as written, aiming to increase loading for each set. Athletes with less experience should consider a coach’s guidance and drill the mechanics before adding weight.

title: Friday 230915

title: Saturday 230916
wodRaw:
5 rounds for time of:    
2-mile (3,200 meter) bike ride  
10 [muscle-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kipping-muscle-up)  
10 [deadlifts](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/foundational-movement-deadlift-what-is-a-deadlift#:~:text=The%20deadlift%20is%20one%20of,head%2Dto%2Dtoe%20strength) 

♀  185 lb ♂ 275 lb 

*Get outside - do the bike ride on a real bike. The more varied terrain you can include, the better!*

**Scaling:**  
If you're unable to ride outside, modify to an [Echo bike](https://cf.games/23_rogue) or [Concept2 BikeErg](https://www.roguefitness.com/concept2-bike-erg?gclid=CjwKCAjw6eWnBhAKEiwADpnw9gfLL2DPMnCz4yzkCv8zieunsOIDkjU-Z99yKJgJxqjISAEiX3l2lBoCxrgQAvD_BwE). If you do not yet have a muscle-up, modify the movement to a pulling and pushing exercise, preferably on the rings. Reduce the loading on the deadlift. 

**Intermediate option:**   
**4 rounds** for time of:    
2-mile (3,200 meter) bike ride  
**7** muscle-ups  
10 deadlifts 

**♀  155 lb ♂ 225 lb**  

**Beginner option:**    
**3 rounds** for time of:    
**1-mile (1,600 meter)** bike ride  
**5x: [3 ring rows + 3 jumping dips]**    
10 deadlifts 

**♀ 65 lb ♂ 95 lb**

title: Monday 230918
wodRaw:
**Nancy**  
5 rounds for time of:   
Run 400 meters  
15 [overhead squats](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-overhead-squat)

♀ 65 lb ♂ 95 lb

OR  

**Helen**  
3 rounds for time of:  
Run 400 meters  
21 [kettlebell swings](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-kettlebell-swing)  
12 [pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-butterfly-pull-up)

♀ 16-kg KB ♂ 24-kg KB

*Default to Nancy, a classic CrossFit workout. [CAP affiliates](https://www.crossfit.com/programming) will be doing Helen today. If you have not completed Helen recently, give it a shot.*

Log Helen scores to the [CrossFit App](https://qrcodes.pro/HLEFX0). Post workout and time to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230918).  
Compare to [230626](https://www.crossfit.com/230626) or [230802](https://www.crossfit.com/230802).  

***

**Scaling:**   
*Nancy:* Choose a load that allows you to complete most of the OHS unbroken. The challenge of this workout is to keep an aggressive pace on each element knowing that neither the lifting nor the running are so demanding on their own that you’ll need extended rests. Advanced athletes should resist the temptation to add load and instead commit to a run pace that’s just a little too hot.

*Helen:* Most athletes should aim to complete the swings and pull-ups unbroken. If you anticipate needing to break either movement more than one or two times, reduce the weight of the swings and consider completing ring rows instead of pull-ups. If you can complete Helen in less than 8 minutes, consider trying [Helena](https://games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2023?_ga=2.134508217.950528661.1693935248-1350194187.1693531355#events-details) from this year’s Games.

title: Tuesday 230919
wodRaw:
[Shoulder press](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-shoulder-press) 5-5-5 reps   
[Push press](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-press) 3-3-3 reps   
[Push jerk](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-push-jerk) 1-1-1 reps 

Attempt to increase the weight after each successful set. 

After completing the final set of each movement, perform a max set of [L-sit pull-ups](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-l-pull-up).

Post loads and L-sit pull-up sets to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230919).  

***
**Scaling:**  
If you cannot complete an L-sit pull-up, choose a variation of pull-up that allows you to complete approximately 10 reps during your first set. If you can complete 1-5 L-sit pull-ups, consider performing a set after each set of overhead lifts instead of after the final set of each movement.   

**Beginner option:**   
Shoulder press 5-5-5 reps   
Push press 3-3-3 reps   
Push jerk 1-1-1 reps   

After completing the final set of each movement, perform a max set of **ring rows.**

15-calorie [row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing)  
9 [burpee box jump-overs](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-burpee-box-jump-over) (♀ 36-inch ♂ 48-inch box)   
21 [box jump-overs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4o2duvMXo1Y&t=42s) (♀ 20-inch ♂ 24-inch box, step-down)    
15-calorie [row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing)  
9 [burpee box jump-overs](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-burpee-box-jump-over) (♀ 36-inch ♂ 48-inch box)   

Rest until 6-minute mark, then:  

9 [burpee box jump-overs](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-burpee-box-jump-over) (♀ 36-inch ♂ 48-inch box)       
15-calorie [row](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/rowing)   
21 [box jump-overs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4o2duvMXo1Y&t=42s) (♀ 20-inch ♂ 24-inch box, step-down)

***

**Scaling:**   
If you anticipate that you cannot finish the first segment with 90 seconds or more to rest, modify the workout to 2 rounds for total time with a 2-minute rest between rounds. Use the step-down approach for both the box jump-overs and the burpee box jump-overs.

title: Friday 230922
wodRaw:
Practice [handstand](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/freestanding-handstand) skills for 15 minutes. 

Rest. Then,  

Complete as many reps as possible in 15 minutes of:   
2-4-6-8-10 reps of:    
[Squat clean](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-clean-2)  
[Wall-facing handstand push-up](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-chest-to-wall-handstand-push-up)  

*Any time you complete the round of 10/10, start over again at 2 reps 

♀ 125 lb ♂ 185 lb  

Post handstand skills and reps completed to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230922).  
***

**Scaling:**   
During the practice choose a skill that matches your current ability level. Aim to get at least 5 working “sets” in 15 minutes. **Beginners** can practice pike holds or holds on the wall. **Intermediate** athletes can practice freestanding handstand holds. **Advanced** athletes can practice pirouettes and pressing to handstand.

Choose a load and HSPU variation that allows you to ‘climb the ladder’ 2x (complete the second round of 10/10).

title: Saturday 230923
wodRaw:

Hill sprint or stairs

If you are unable to find a hill or set of stairs, complete 10 100-meter sprints or 20-second intervals on a stationary bike for total calories.

title: Saturday 230930
wodRaw:
15 minutes to build to a heavy single [power snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-snatch)  
Then,   
Power snatch 2-2-2-2-2 at 80% 

Post snatch load to [comments](https://www.crossfit.com/230930). 
***  
**Scaling:**  
Watch “[The Power Snatch](https://www.crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-snatch)” and focus on going heavy from the ground to overhead. All athletes can go heavy in the power snatch, with newer athletes focusing on solid mechanics. Calculate 80% of your heaviest successful lift, and perform 5 sets of 2 reps.
